P1 would end up with both utilities and cash, but they're still far from a monopoly since they lack Kentucky/Illinois and New York is unowned, so handing them cash doesn't seem too risky — I'd drop from 1235 to 935.

This feels like a fair deal; railroads are strong early game and p1 isn't close to completing any set, so I'll just accept rather than counter.
